gravity_torque_study.positive_torque_direction: Increasing gate angle toward the 60 degree open stop.
gravity_torque_study.scope: Static moving-part gravity torque per kg from saved-solid centroids; no oil forces, acceleration transients, hinge friction or response time.
gravity_torque_study.attitude_cases: Declared 15 degree effective-gravity directions in the pan-proxy XYZ frame; design stress cases, not vehicle attitudes.
gravity_torque_study.mass_model: Uniform density across each stainless moving gate assembly; fixed pins excluded.

digital_installation_path_spec.path: Straight vertical translation at the installed XY placement and yaw.
digital_installation_path_spec.sampling: Exact BRep overlap at 1 mm translation increments; continuous motion between samples is not proven.
digital_installation_path_spec.pickup_tube_removed: Pickup keepout and suction-tube proxy omitted together; screen separation is not modelled.

digital_alternative_exit_path_study.scope: Nominal pan proxy only; closed gates and removed cover. The pickup/tube proxy stays installed. Each declared lateral shift or tilt is attempted at installed height before vertical lift.
digital_alternative_exit_path_study.coordinate_frame: Pan-proxy XYZ; not a measured vehicle frame.
digital_alternative_exit_path_study.shift_sampling: 1 mm increments; tilt sampling uses 1 degree increments.

nominal_visual_proxy.label: Nominal pan proxy
nominal_visual_proxy.scope: Digital sensitivity case only; not measured pan geometry.

cover_12mm_lower_stress.label: Cover underside 12 mm lower
cover_12mm_lower_stress.description: Cover underside lowered by 12 mm as a design sensitivity case.
cover_12mm_lower_stress.scope: Digital sensitivity case only; not measured pan geometry.

pickup_and_tube_25pct_larger_stress.label: Pickup and tube 25% larger
pickup_and_tube_25pct_larger_stress.description: Pickup and tube test envelopes enlarged by 25 percent.
pickup_and_tube_25pct_larger_stress.scope: Digital sensitivity case only; not measured pan geometry.

pickup_route_offset_stress.label: Pickup route shifted +12 / −8 mm
pickup_route_offset_stress.description: Pickup screen and tube route shifted together by +12/-8 mm in proxy X/Y.
pickup_route_offset_stress.scope: Digital sensitivity case only; not measured pan geometry.

narrower_shell_stress.label: Pan interior narrowed
narrower_shell_stress.description: Pan interior scale reduced by 0.04 in X and Y.
narrower_shell_stress.scope: Digital sensitivity case only; not measured pan geometry.

limits: Discrete sampled poses only; no continuous sweep guarantee.
Independent doors are checked pairwise at declared angle combinations, not every possible angle.
Pan interior, tube, pickup keepout, cover and placement are explicitly assumed proxies.
Installation paths use the saved closed-door pose, removed cover, fixed XY/yaw and 1 mm translation samples.
Named stress cases are deliberate design sensitivities, not measured uncertainty bounds or predictions of the actual pan.
Gravity torque uses uniform-density moving-solid centroids and selected effective-gravity vectors; it excludes oil forces, friction and transient response.
Alternative exit paths are eight selected nominal-proxy sensitivities; shifts/tilts start at installed height, and the first collision does not prove no other path exists.
Passing proxy clearance does not establish OEM fit, oil control, thermal or fabrication clearance.
